MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The adhesive-lined heat shrink felt useful because it could insulate and seal connections made with my earlier crimp terminals.",
    "The epoxy felt like a sensible addition to my tape and vinyl cement because it could handle rigid repairs where those materials are unsuitable."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The battery lugs and small threaded valve require specific wire sizes or fittings that my earlier connector and hose-clamp purchases do not establish I need.",
    "The grinding discs, cutting wheels, feeler gauge, thermometer, and lubricant would need a particular job to justify choosing them; I have no current task for them.",
    "The larger heat-shrink assortment fits my wiring interests, but I would choose the adhesive-lined kit this time rather than buy two overlapping supplies."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair-supply purchases seemed to be treated as interest in almost any workshop or maintenance product.",
    "Buying clamps and electrical connectors seemed to imply a need for other plumbing and wiring parts without enough attention to their dimensions or purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "A clear connection to a repair I can actually make matters more to me than a broad resemblance to things I have bought.",
    "Compatibility matters: small-wire crimp terminals do not imply a need for heavy battery cable lugs, and hose clamps do not identify a required valve thread.",
    "Useful alternatives can satisfy the same need; liking both heat-shrink kits does not mean I would choose both now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical repair supplies but stretched it into specialized purchases without a clear task or compatibility match."
}
